label: MORNING BRIEF

stories.title: No toilet? Landlords face arrest
stories.story: KCCA warned landlords who give tenants no toilet that they risk arrest and prosecution. Checks will run across all Kampala divisions.
stories.you: Listing a rental? Check the toilets first before you show it.

stories.title: Shs18m each for Ntoroko families
stories.story: Government is weighing Shs18m per household to resettle flood victims from Ntoroko’s Kanara camp. Land first quoted at Shs26m an acre was cut to Shs16m.
stories.you: Land for resettlement is in demand. Know local acre prices before you quote.

stories.title: Lubigi floods cut Hoima Road
stories.story: Heavy rain on Friday made Hoima Road at Lubigi, by the Northern Bypass, impassable. Police told drivers to use other routes.
stories.you: Selling near Lubigi? Be open about flooding before buyers find out.

stories.title: Kayunga–Galiraya road going tarmac
stories.story: CRBC is upgrading the 87km Kayunga–Bbaale–Galiraya road from gravel to bitumen. It maintained an 18km stretch on 20 November.
stories.you: Plots on the route may gain. List roadside land early, clear of the reserve.

stories.title: 7,000 face Mount Kei eviction
stories.story: EU envoys urged a peaceful eviction of more than 7,000 people settled in the 40,689-hectare Mount Kei forest reserve in Koboko.
stories.you: Never sell forest land. Check reserve boundaries before any deal.
